label: default agent • add a provider with an api_key_ref secret reference
query: Set up an OpenAI provider named "OpenAI" using the API key from my OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable — don't ask me to paste it.
notes: Phase 4 secrets-by-reference: `api_key_ref: env:OPENAI_API_KEY` stores the key non-interactively at apply; the raw key never appears in the document. Pins the ref key and the env reference. A model that pastes a placeholder secret instead of the ref fails the api_key_ref probe.
